name: Menlo Engineering Associates, Inc.
what_they_do: Civil engineering and landscape architecture consultancy doing site engineering, land planning, wetland/environmental work, highway design and construction administration for development projects across New Jersey. Established 1966 per the site, with discipline-level service pages and a project portfolio by sector.
customers: Property developers, commercial/industrial and residential builders, and municipal/public agencies

size_signals.signal: Established 1966; site claims 3,000+ planning and design projects completed
Dedicated Our Leadership, Clients & Testimonials, Careers and News sections plus a project map
Third-party directory lists 11-50 employees, founded 1966 (unverified third-party data)

listing.platform: Google Business Profile (Menlo Engineering Associates Inc.)

website_review.primary_cta: None on the home page; contact form lives on the Contact Us page
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Contact form (Gravity Forms) - no quote workflow or booking
website_review.trust_signals: Since 1966, stated 3,000+ projects, project portfolio and project map, client testimonials section, leadership pages, active careers page
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Footer still reads '(c) 2024' and 'via WordPress Web Design Agency'; home page has no h1 and almost no content below the hero (a background video plus one paragraph, so the rest of the page rendered blank)
website_review.search_basics: Home title and meta description name civil engineering in NJ; service pages segmented by discipline; Organization schema carries a phone but no address; sitemap present
top_issues: Home page is a single hero with one paragraph - no services summary, no address, no CTA, and almost nothing for a crawler or visitor to read
No tel: link on the home page and no CTA above the fold at either width
Organization JSON-LD lacks address and LocalBusiness type despite a full address on the contact page
Footer copyright stale at 2024 and design-agency credit left in place

agent_readiness.notes: robots.txt only restricts /wp-admin, so all major AI and search crawlers can read the site. GBP shows address, phone and hours (Mon-Fri 8:30-5). The contact page has full address, services text and hours, but the home page is nearly text-free and schema is Organization-only with a telephone and no address, so structured data does not match the page. The contact form has labelled fields (Name, Email, Phone, Message) and a submit button; a reCAPTCHA/honeypot script loads on the page, which could impede an agent mid-flow, and there is no booking or quote engine.

operations_signals.signal: Careers page and a 'We're hiring!' prompt on the contact page - likely growing or replacing staff
Project intake is a generic contact form with no scope/parcel fields, so an engineer must manually qualify each enquiry (inference)

top_opportunities.opportunity: Rebuild the home page around services, project types, municipalities served and a single 'Start a project' CTA, with real text for crawlers and AI assistants
top_opportunities.evidence: Home page height ~1,080px with one paragraph and a background video; no h1, no address, no CTA

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add a scoped project-inquiry intake (municipality, parcel size, project type, timeline, file upload) that routes to the right engineer
top_opportunities.evidence: Contact form currently collects only Name/Email/Phone/Message

top_opportunities.opportunity: Upgrade schema to LocalBusiness/ProfessionalService with address, geo, areaServed and services, matching the contact page
top_opportunities.evidence: Single JSON-LD graph with Organization (name, telephone, logo, sameAs) but no address or LocalBusiness type

scores.reasons: Gap: an established 1966 firm whose home page is effectively blank below the hero and whose schema omits the address. Ability to pay: civil engineering on development projects bills high per-project fees. Ease: WordPress with existing service pages, so homepage and schema work is fast. Evidence: rendered both widths, extracted JSON-LD, robots.txt and GBP.

wrong_claims.claim: Listing rating/reviews 'not shown' on the Google profile
wrong_claims.what_is_true: Google Maps shows 'Menlo Engineering Associates Inc, 5.0, Civil engineer' with address, phone and hours, so a rating is displayed; the review count is not visible in the limited view.
